name: Heroes of Anirea
storyline:
Imagine an old man, tale telling the histories of how some heroes saved an old fantasy world to his grandchildren.

That's what our campaign wants to make you feel, like you are one of the excited child freeing your imagination to tie up the loose ends of the story.

Anirea is a medieval fantasy world with familiar and recognizable elements. In this world, every person is born with their soul bound to an element, which allows them to store and control its power to a greater or lesser extent depending on their magical potential and training. The five elements are: Gaia, Aqua, Ignis, Tempest, and Aero.

The main continent is divided into four regions: The Kingdom of Quidalia, where magic and knowledge are everything; Solaris, the land of the fierce human warriors of the south; Vhal Dorel, the forested eastern territory inhabited by tribes of elves and feranids; and Nordskaald, the cold, mountainous kingdom that contends with the threat of dragons. Added to these are the islands of the Ansiara Archipelago to the west, a volcanic region.

Through campaigns set in a roguelite environment, the player will experience the journey of the heroes who saved Anirea—their path, their choices, the dangers they faced, and the friends who aided them.
summary: Heroes of Anirea blends turn-based tactics with roguelite progression in a character-driven strategy experience. Assemble your squad from a diverse cast of heroes, each with unique skills, and evolve your approach as new challenges arise.
